title: A New Proof of Wei's Theorem
summary: In the paper \emph{Structure and realizability for rational maps}, Wei proved the following. Let \(k\) nontrivial partitions of an integer \(d\ge 3\) be given, satisfying the Riemann--Hurwitz formula for the case of maps between two spheres. If \(k>\ell+1\), where \[ \ell=\min_i|π_i| \] is the shortest partition length, then there exists a rational map whose branch datum is given by these partitions. In this paper we give a new proof of Wei's theorem on realizing a tuple of partitions as the ramification data of a rational function. The proof is inductive on the shortest partition length.…
